name: Basewright: Verify
description: Read a running instance back and say whether it is still what its plan promised. Changes nothing, and can be run months after the apply. Takes a host and an instance name rather than a plan id: the store remembers which plan that instance was applied from. A mismatch ends the task red and the log names every check that did not match.

survey_vars.name: basewright_hosts
survey_vars.title: Host
survey_vars.description: The host to read, as the inventory names it.

survey_vars.name: basewright_instance
survey_vars.title: Instance name
survey_vars.description: Which instance on that host. The store is asked which plan it was applied from, so no plan id has to be remembered.
